Calls for Participation


The deadlines for posters and software exhibitions are now passed but limited space is available for late submissions. For consideration of posters please email issac07posters@cs.uwaterloo.ca directly; do not use the Easy Chair page for posters. Also note that for late submissions there can be no guarantee of exhibition space, publication of abstract, or eligibility for awards.

A copy of the printed call for participation is available as a PDF.
